product.title: Secrets of Grand Central Station Walking Tour New York City
product.description: Millions of travelers pass through New York City's Grand Central Terminal, but most never discover the secrets behind its elegant architecture. This small-group tour reveals the origins and evolution of the Beaux Arts train station from its heyday to disrepair and restoration. Spot detail and design quirks; and hear stories of its past that will give you a deeper understanding of the landmark building than you could get alone.
highlights: Discover the secrets of Grand Central Terminal from your guide
Learn about detail and design features not obvious to untrained eyes
Uncover surprising gems and historical tales you may not experience otherwise
Enjoy a tour capped at 15 that's ideal for history and architecture buffs
inclusions: Guided walking tour led by a local New Yorker
Ear pieces provided to each guests, ensuring everyone hears the guide perfectly, even from a distance

start.description: Grand Central Terminal, 89 E 42nd St, New York, NY 10017, USA. The tour starts in front of Track 29, inside Grand Central Terminal's main concourse.

end.description: This activity ends back at the meeting point.
